response.description: SQL database in Fabric is now generally available. Built on the trusted SQL Server and Azure SQL Database engine, this fully SaaS-native solution empowers developers and data professionals to unify operational and analytical workloads with speed, security, and AI-powered capabilities. Key highlights include fast provisioning, Copilot-powered management, autonomous scaling, enterprise-grade security (with Customer Managed Keys and SQL Auditing), and native support for AI scenarios like semantic search and RAG.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: SQL database in Microsoft Fabric
